sentences.en: You should spend a little time each day reviewing vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 你每天应该花一点时间复习词汇。

sentences.en: Do you know a good way to memorize new vocabulary?
sentences.zh: 你知道一个好的记忆新词汇的方法吗？

sentences.en: I would rather read a nice novel than study vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 与其背单词，我宁愿读一本好小说。

senses.zh: （某一语言的）词汇,（尤指外语教科书中附有释义的）词汇表
